mindwarden_enclave_initializer = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	max_instances = 1
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				has_shroud_dlc = yes
				add = @spawn_system_extreme
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				any_country = {
					has_origin = origin_mindwardens
				}
			}
		}
	flags = {
			mindwarden_enclave_system
			enclave
		}
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "random" type = mindwarden_enclave }
	}
}
